cf920c6f.yl: Yield: 10 portions (20 tikki) · Portion: 2 tikki + toppings ≈ 250 g

Shape 20 patties 1.5 cm; shallow-fry 3–4 min each side until crisp.
Whisk yoghurt with sugar and a pinch of salt.
Plate 2 hot tikki on warm spiced chickpeas; spoon over yoghurt, tamarind and 15 g Hari Chutney (see its TTK).
Finish with onion, pomegranate, chaat masala, chilli and coriander.

Blend smooth; pass through a sieve; cool.

Fry at 175 °C 5–6 min until crisp (core 75 °C); drain.
Toss in a hot wok with oil, curry leaves, slit chillies and garlic 30 s.
Coat in batter of flour, starch, paste, chilli, salt and water; fry at 180 °C 4 min; re-fry 1 min for crunch.
Stir-fry chopped garlic, ginger and chilli; add diced onion and pepper 1 min.

Mix with mashed potato, grated paneer, aromatics, spices and toasted gram flour.

Blend soaked cashews, cream cheese, cream, yoghurt, cardamom and chilli smooth; coat chicken; marinate 4 h.

Add flours, aromatics and spices; add water only to bind into a thick, sticky mix.
Drop loose 40 g heaps into oil at 170 °C; fry 4–5 min until deep golden and crisp; drain.
Blend herbs, chilli, ginger and lemon to a fine paste with 2 tbsp ice water.
Stir into yoghurt with cumin and salt; chill.

2d055d27.yl: Yield: 10 portions (20 skewers) · Portion: 2 skewers ≈ 180 g

Cut paneer, peppers and onion into 3 cm pieces; coat; marinate 1–4 h at 4 °C.
Thread alternately on skewers; grill or roast 240 °C 8–10 min until charred at the edges.
Brush with ghee; sprinkle chaat masala; serve with mint chutney.
Blend herbs, chilli, ginger and lemon to a fine paste with 2 tbsp ice water.
Stir into yoghurt with cumin and salt; chill.

30cb912e.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 6 puri + 120 g pani

Mix with remaining water, lemon and spices; chill well (it must be ice-cold).
Boil and dice potatoes 5 mm; mix with chickpeas, onion, chaat masala, chilli and coriander.
At service crack each puri on top; fill 1 tsp filling and a little tamarind chutney; dip in pani and eat at once.

b7f6f4da.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 250 g bhaji + 2 pav

Fry onion in half the butter; add paste, peppers and tomatoes; cook 10 min to a pulp.
Add chilli, masala, turmeric and mashed vegetables; mash together on the flat-top 10 min, adding water to a thick, spreadable curry.

Split pav; toast on the griddle in butter with a pinch of masala.

0ab74fa0.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 vada pav ≈ 190 g

Dip and fry at 175 °C 3–4 min until golden.
Dry garlic chutney: toast coconut and garlic; pound with chilli and salt.
Split pav; spread green chutney and dry garlic chutney; insert hot vada.

Dust with chaat masala; serve with lemon, onion rings and green chutney.
b82e9993.st: Marinated raw fish 0–3 °C 12 h max; cook to order.
b82e9993.al: 4 Fish (monkfish fillet, 4 cm pieces) · 7 Milk (hung yoghurt, butter, melted) · 10 Mustard (mustard oil). Contains fish, milk, mustard.

c: Toss prawns with salt and turmeric; fry briefly in a little oil 2 min; set aside.
Soak chillies, spices and dried shrimp in vinegar 30 min; grind to a fine paste with garlic and ginger.
Fry finely chopped onions in oil 15 min until deep brown; add tomato and masala; fry 10 min until oil separates.
Add sugar, salt and prawns; cook 3 min; core ≥63 °C. The masala should be thick and clinging.
Best rested 24 h; serve warm with rice.
fc7b93fe.st: 0–3 °C 5 days in a clean, covered container.
fc7b93fe.al: 2 Crustaceans (prawns, peeled, deveined, dried shrimp) · 14 Sulphites (coconut vinegar). Contains crustaceans, sulphites.

c: Pearl spot or sea bream fillets, 180 g
Marinate fish with spices, lemon and salt 30 min; sear in coconut oil 1 min per side.
Fry sliced shallots, ginger, garlic, chillies and curry leaves 10 min; add tomato, spices and kokum; cook 8 min; add coconut milk; reduce until thick.
Wilt banana leaves over a flame; place masala, fish, more masala; fold and tie.
Cook parcels on a griddle or at 200 °C 12 min, turning once; core ≥63 °C. Serve in the leaf.
813f86ba.st: Masala 0–3 °C 72 h; assemble and cook to order.
813f86ba.al: 4 Fish (pearl spot or sea bream fillets, 180 g). Contains fish.

c: Boil eggs 10 min; chill in iced water; peel; score lightly. Toss in oil with turmeric and chilli; fry 2 min until blistered.
Fry cumin and bay leaves; add finely chopped onions; cook 15 min until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic and chillies, then puréed tomato and ground spices; cook 15 min until oil separates.
Add water and salt; simmer 10 min; add eggs, garam masala and kasuri methi; simmer 5 min; core ≥75 °C. Finish with coriander.
6f488905.st: Gravy 0–3 °C 72 h; peeled eggs 0–3 °C 48 h; combine to order.

c: Soak cashews 20 min; blend with a little water to a smooth paste.
Fry cumin in butter and oil; add finely chopped onions; cook 12 min until golden; add ginger-garlic; cook 2 min.
Add chopped tomatoes and spices; cook 15 min; blend half to a purée, keep half chunky.
Add cashew paste, water, sugar and salt; simmer 8 min; add paneer cubes, grated paneer and cream; heat 3 min; core ≥75 °C.
Finish with kasuri methi and coriander.
0252574a.st: Gravy 0–3 °C 72 h; add paneer to order.
0252574a.al: 7 Milk (paneer, 2 cm cubes, paneer, grated, butter, double cream) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Contains milk, nuts.

c: Fry cumin in ghee and oil; add finely chopped onion, chilli and ginger; cook 6 min until soft.
Add diced pepper and tomato; cook 6 min until the tomato breaks down.
Add turmeric, chilli, pav bhaji masala and salt; add crumbled paneer and milk; toss over medium heat 3 min until hot and moist; core ≥75 °C.
Finish with coriander. Serve with pav, paratha or as a filling.
b04444c7.st: Cook to order or within 1 h; cooked 0–3 °C 48 h.
b04444c7.al: 7 Milk (paneer, crumbled, ghee, milk). Contains milk.

c: Boil sliced onions, cashews and melon seeds in water 10 min; blend very smooth.
Fry whole spices in ghee; add ginger-garlic 1 min; add the white paste; cook 8 min without colouring.
Whisk in yoghurt off the heat; return and simmer 5 min, stirring; add white pepper, mace, cardamom, sugar, salt and saffron soaked in warm cream.
Add paneer; simmer 4 min; core ≥75 °C. Finish with kewra.
698bad09.st: Gravy 0–3 °C 72 h; add paneer to order.
698bad09.al: 7 Milk (paneer, 2 cm cubes, ghee, yoghurt, full-fat, double cream) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Contains milk, nuts.

c: Chop methi; rub with salt; rest 10 min; squeeze out bitter juice.
Boil onions, ginger, chillies and cashews in water 8 min; drain; blend smooth with the milk.
Fry cumin in butter; add methi; cook 4 min; add the white paste; simmer 6 min.
Add peas (blanched if fresh), cream, sugar, salt and garam masala; simmer 4 min; core ≥75 °C.
8f1f8d57.st: 0–3 °C 48 h; reheat gently, add milk if thick.
8f1f8d57.al: 7 Milk (butter, milk, double cream) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Contains milk, nuts.

c: Peel potatoes; cut 2 cm cubes; par-boil 6 min in salted water; drain and steam-dry.
Chop methi; rub with salt; rest 10 min; squeeze.
Fry cumin, sliced garlic and dried chillies in oil; add potatoes and ground spices; fry 10 min until golden edges.
Add methi and green chillies; cook 6 min until wilted and dry; finish with amchur and salt; core ≥75 °C.
Slit aubergines in a cross keeping the stem; salt; fry in oil 8 min until soft and coloured; remove.
Dry-roast peanuts, sesame, coconut, coriander and cumin until fragrant; roast sliced onions until golden; grind all with ginger-garlic and a little water to a fine paste.
In the same oil crackle mustard, cumin, nigella, fenugreek and curry leaves; add the paste, turmeric and chilli; fry 8 min until oil separates.
Add tamarind, jaggery, water and salt; simmer 10 min; add aubergines; cook 8 min; core ≥75 °C. Rest 30 min before serving.
941b7e83.al: 5 Peanuts (roasted peanuts) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Contains peanuts, mustard, sesame.

c: Mix muthia ingredients to a soft dough; shape 4 cm dumplings; fry at 170 °C 4 min until golden.
Mix masala; stuff half into slit aubergines and potatoes.
Heat oil; add ajwain and asafoetida; layer beans and peas, then root vegetables, banana and stuffed vegetables; scatter remaining masala.
Add water; cover tightly; cook on low heat 40 min, shaking the pan, not stirring. Add muthia for the last 10 min; core ≥75 °C.
dc8f717b.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, coarse, asafoetida) · 5 Peanuts (roasted peanuts, crushed) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Contains gluten, peanuts, sesame.

c: Shred cabbage and carrot very fine (2 mm).
Pulse coconut, garlic and cumin coarse.
Crackle mustard, urad dal, chillies and curry leaves in coconut oil; add sliced shallots and green chillies; cook 2 min.
Add cabbage, carrot, turmeric and salt; cover; cook 5 min; add coconut; toss 3 min until dry and just tender.
Sear mushrooms in batches in a very hot pan with oil and salt until coloured; drain.
Fry cumin; add chopped onions 12 min until brown; add ginger-garlic, then tomato and spices; cook 12 min until oil separates.
Char onion petals and pepper squares on high heat 2 min, keeping them crisp.
Add mushrooms and their juices to the masala; cook 4 min; fold in onion petals and pepper, garam masala and kasuri methi; core ≥75 °C. Finish with coriander.
cde33715.st: Masala 0–3 °C 72 h; sear mushrooms and finish to order.

c: Wash greens well; chop. Simmer with ginger, garlic, chillies, water and salt 45 min until very soft.
Whisk in maize flour; cook 15 min, stirring, then blend or mash coarse (not smooth).
Fry chopped onion, garlic and chillies in ghee 8 min until golden; stir into the saag; simmer 10 min; core ≥75 °C.
Serve topped with a knob of butter, with makki di roti.
Slit chillies lengthwise; seed if needed; fry in oil 3 min until blistered; remove.
Dry-roast peanuts, sesame, coconut, coriander and cumin; roast onion; grind with ginger-garlic to a smooth paste.
Crackle mustard, cumin, nigella and curry leaves; add the paste, turmeric and chilli; fry 8 min.
Add tamarind, jaggery, water and salt; simmer 10 min; add chillies; cook 5 min; core ≥75 °C. Serve with biryani.
41f1654a.al: 5 Peanuts (roasted peanuts) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Contains peanuts, mustard, sesame.

c: Soak moong dal 2 h; drain well (it stays raw and crunchy).
Dice cucumber 5 mm; grate carrot; chop chillies and coriander.
Crackle mustard seeds, asafoetida and curry leaves in oil; cool.
Just before service toss dal, vegetables, coconut, tempering, lemon and salt.
79285ea1.st: Soaked dal and vegetables separately 0–3 °C 24 h; dress to order.
79285ea1.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Contains gluten, mustard.

c: Cook rice in water 20 min until very soft; mash lightly while hot; cool to 40 °C.
Stir in milk, then yoghurt and salt (milk keeps it from souring too fast).
Crackle mustard, dals, chopped chillies, ginger, curry leaves and asafoetida in oil; fold into the rice.
Chill to 0–5 °C within 90 min; serve cool with pomegranate, grated cucumber and coriander.
eea80523.st: 0–3 °C 24 h; loosen with milk before service.
eea80523.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 7 Milk (milk, yoghurt, full-fat) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Contains gluten, milk, mustard.

c: Wash and soak basmati 30 min; drain.
Fry whole spices in ghee; add rice; toast 2 min; add water, warm milk with saffron, sugar, salt, fennel and ginger.
Boil, then cover and cook on low heat 12 min; rest 10 min; fluff.
Fry nuts in ghee until golden; add raisins, sliced apricots and diced apple 1 min. Fold through the rice with rose water; top with pomegranate.
5944ef67.st: Rice 0–3 °C 24 h after rapid cooling (≤5 °C within 90 min); reheat to ≥75 °C once.
5944ef67.al: 7 Milk (ghee, milk) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts, almonds, blanched, walnuts). Contains milk, nuts.

c: Marinate prawns with turmeric, chilli, lemon and salt 20 min.

Fry sliced onions in ghee and oil 15 min until golden; add ginger-garlic and chillies, then tomato; cook 8 min. Add yoghurt and biryani masala; cook 5 min; add prawns; cook 3 min (they finish in the dum). Fold in herbs.
Fry whole spices in ghee; add soaked rice and water with salt; boil 7 min until 80 % cooked; drain.
Layer masala and rice in a heavy pot with birista, nuts, raisins, saffron milk and ghee. Seal; dum on low heat or at 160 °C 20 min; core ≥75 °C.
104aec69.st: Serve within 2 h hot (≥63 °C) or cool rapidly; 0–3 °C 24 h; reheat once.
104aec69.al: 2 Crustaceans (prawns, peeled, deveined) · 7 Milk (ghee, yoghurt, full-fat, milk) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts, fried). Contains crustaceans, milk, nuts.

c: Mix flour, semolina, baking powder, soda, sugar and salt; add yoghurt, oil and water; knead 8 min to a soft, smooth dough.
Cover; rest 2–4 h at 25 °C until slightly puffy.
Divide 140 g balls; oil lightly; roll 18 cm oval, 4 mm thick.
Fry one at a time at 190 °C, pressing gently so it balloons; 40 s per side until pale gold. Drain; serve at once with chole.
d60f4896.al: 1 Gluten (plain flour, semolina) · 7 Milk (yoghurt, full-fat). Contains gluten, milk.

c: Chop methi fine; mix with all dough ingredients; knead to a soft, non-sticky dough; rest 20 min.
Divide 35 g balls; roll very thin (1–2 mm), 16 cm.
Cook on a hot tawa 30 s; turn; brush with oil; cook both sides until golden spots, 2 min total.
Stack in a cloth. Serve warm or room temperature with pickle and yoghurt.
43cb3d19.st: Cooled thepla airtight 4 days at 18 °C or 0–3 °C 7 days; good travel bread.
43cb3d19.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, coarse) · 7 Milk (yoghurt, full-fat) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Contains gluten, milk, sesame.

c: Soak rice 5 h; drain; grind with coconut and 400 g water to a very fine paste.
Thin with the remaining water to a watery batter (like milk); add salt. No fermentation needed.
Heat an oiled non-stick tawa; stir batter; pour from the edge in a circle to fill the pan with a lacy layer.
Cover 1 min until set and white (do not brown); fold into quarters. Serve with coconut chutney or chicken sukka.
be87ed76.st: Batter 0–3 °C 24 h; stir before use; cook to order.

c: Soak rice and dal with fenugreek separately 5 h; grind to a slightly coarse batter; ferment 10–12 h at 25–30 °C until doubled. Add salt.
Chop onion, tomato, chillies, coriander and ginger fine.
Pour 160 g batter on a hot tawa; spread to 15 cm, 1 cm thick; scatter toppings and press in; drizzle oil.
Cook 3 min until golden underneath; flip; cook 2 min. Serve with sambar and chutney.
Cook rice and dal together with water and turmeric 25 min until soft and porridge-like.
Dry-roast spice powder ingredients in order until fragrant; grind fine.
Cook vegetables in water with salt 10 min; add tamarind, jaggery and the spice powder; simmer 8 min.
Combine with the rice and dal; simmer 10 min, loosening with hot water to a soft pouring consistency; core ≥75 °C.
Fry mustard, cashews, curry leaves and asafoetida in ghee; pour over. Serve with boondi and papad.
f2e03dc5.st: 0–3 °C 48 h; thickens on standing, reheat with water.
f2e03dc5.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 7 Milk (ghee) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts) · 10 Mustard (mustard seeds). Contains gluten, milk, nuts, mustard.

c: Fry dals and chillies in oil until golden; add shallots and garlic 4 min; add chopped tomato; cook 12 min until thick.
Cool; grind with tamarind and salt to a smooth chutney.
Crackle mustard, curry leaves and asafoetida in oil; pour over.
45936764.st: 0–3 °C 5 days in a clean, covered container.

c: Grind roasted gram, coconut, chillies, ginger, tamarind and salt with water to a smooth, thick chutney.
Crackle mustard, urad dal, curry leaves and chilli in coconut oil; pour over.
Soak boondi in warm water 5 min; squeeze gently.
Whisk yoghurt with milk until smooth; add cumin, black salt and salt.
Fold in boondi; chill. Finish with chilli powder and chopped herbs.
b82a68ed.st: 0–3 °C 24 h; add boondi within 2 h of service for best texture.

c: Dry-roast dals separately on low heat until golden and nutty; roast chillies in a little oil until crisp; toast sesame and curry leaves.
Cool completely; grind with asafoetida, jaggery and salt to a coarse powder.
Serve 10 g with sesame oil or ghee alongside idli or dosa.
01646ba5.al: 1 Gluten (asafoetida) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds, sesame oil). Contains gluten, sesame.

c: Dry-roast cumin, coriander, pepper and ajwain on low heat 3 min until fragrant; cool.
Grind fine with dried mint; sift.
Mix with all remaining powders; sift again.
Make chhena: boil 3 l full-fat milk; turn off; add 90 g lemon juice diluted in 90 g water; stir until clear whey separates. Strain through muslin; rinse with cold water; hang 45 min (moist, not dry).
Knead chhena with semolina on the bench 8 min until smooth and the palm greases slightly. Roll 36 crack-free balls of 15 g.
Boil sugar, water and cardamom in a wide pot; add balls; cover; boil hard 15 min (they double); do not uncover in the first 8 min.
Cool in the syrup; add rose water; chill to 0–5 °C. Serve cold.
Grind cashews in short pulses to a fine dry powder (do not let it turn oily); sift.
Boil sugar and water to one-thread syrup (106 °C). Lower the heat; add cashew powder; stir 4–6 min until it forms a soft dough that leaves the pan.
Add ghee and cardamom; cool on a greased sheet until warm; knead smooth.
Roll between baking paper to 5 mm; apply vark; cut into 4 cm diamonds. Cool fully.
c50e7780.al: 7 Milk (ghee) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Contains milk, nuts.

c: Soak rice 1 h; drain; grind to a coarse semolina-like paste with a little milk.
Boil milk; whisk in the rice; cook on low heat 15 min, stirring constantly, until thick and creamy.
Add sugar, cardamom and saffron; cook 5 min; off the heat add rose water.
Pour into wetted clay pots (shikoras); chill ≥4 h to 0–5 °C. Top with slivered nuts and petals.
ef900536.al: 7 Milk (milk, full-fat) · 8 Nuts (pistachios, almonds, blanched). Contains milk, nuts.

c: Reduce milk in a wide pan over medium heat 50 min, scraping the skin from the sides back in, to one third. Add sugar and cardamom; cool; add kewra; chill.
Boil sugar, water, cardamom and saffron 5 min to a light syrup.
Remove crusts; cut bread into triangles; shallow-fry in ghee at 160 °C until deep golden and crisp; drain.
Dip bread in warm syrup 5 s; plate; cover with cold rabri; finish with nuts and vark.
7de507b9.st: Rabri 0–3 °C 72 h; fried bread airtight 24 h; assemble to order.
7de507b9.al: 1 Gluten (white bread, thick slices) · 7 Milk (ghee, milk, full-fat) · 8 Nuts (pistachios, almonds, blanched). Contains gluten, milk, nuts.

c: Sift gram flour; whisk with 100 g warm melted ghee to a smooth, lump-free paste.
Keep the rest of the ghee hot (90 °C) on the side. Boil sugar and water to one-thread syrup (106 °C).
Lower heat; whisk in the besan paste; add hot ghee a ladle at a time, stirring constantly, 8–10 min, until it froths, honeycombs and leaves the sides.
Pour at once into a greased 20 cm tin; level; cut into squares while warm; cool 2 h before removing.
Roast vermicelli in ghee 4 min until golden.
Add milk; simmer 10 min until soft; add sugar, condensed milk, cardamom and saffron; simmer 5 min.
Fry cashews and raisins in ghee until golden and plump; pour over.
Serve warm, or chill to 0–5 °C (it thickens; loosen with milk).
2fd32450.al: 1 Gluten (semiya) · 7 Milk (ghee, milk, full-fat, condensed milk) · 8 Nuts (cashew nuts). Contains gluten, milk, nuts.

Crackle mustard, curry leaves and asafoetida in oil; stir in.
